chapter.verse: Upna in lametnate telcianna hi a, a kimu nai lo nate theihtelna ahi hi.
Tua upna hangin tanglai mite in teci pan’na a ngah uh hi.
A kimu nate in a kilang nate sung pan piang hi loin, leitungte in Pasian’ thupiakna tawh a piang hi ci-in eite in upna tawh i thei hi.

Abel in Kain’ biakna sangin a hoihzaw biakna, upna tawh Pasian a bia hi. Tua ahih ciangin dik hi ci-in teci pan’na a ngah hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama piaknate Pasian in a sang hi. Tua ahih ciangin Abel in a si napi-in a upna hangin thu a hilh lai hi.
Enok in upna hangin sihna tawh kipelhin a kilato hi. Pasian in amah kilatosak ahih ciangin a kimu nawn kei hi. Amah a kilak toh ma-in Pasian a lungdamsak hi ci-in teci pan’na a ngah hi.

Upna loin Pasian kilungdamsak zo lo hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian kiang a nai mi-in Pasian a om hi cih ahi zongin, cihtakna tawh amah a zong mite amah in thaman a piapa hi cih ahi zongin a um ding hi.

Noah in a muh nai loh thute-ah thupiakkholhna a ngah khit ciangin upna tawh Pasian kihta-in ama innkuanpihte gum dingin teembaw a lam hi. Tua upna hangin amah in leitung mite mawhna thu khenin a upna tawh kipawl dikkisakna a luah hi.
Abraham in a luah nading a cih gamah a paikhiat nading Pasian in a sap ciangin amah in koi lamah pai ding cih thei lo napi-in, upna tawh thungai-in a paikhia hi.
Ama theih lohna gamah zinte bangin om a, thuciamna tawh a kipawl gamah upna tawh zin mi-in a om hi. Tua a thuciamna a luahpih Isaak leh Jakob tawh bukte sungah teengkhawm uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a luah ding Pasian’ lamsa, bulpi kip a nei khuapi a lamen hi.
Sarah in a teek khit ciangin ta gai theihna thu vangliatna, upna tawh a ngah hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thu a ciampa in thumanpa ahi ci-in a um hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi si tawh a kibang dektak, mi khat bek ahi Abraham panin a kisim ciangin aksi zah ahi zongin, tuipi gei-ah a kisim zo lo sehnelte zah ahi zongin tampite a suak uh hi.
Tua a kigensa mi khempeuhte in thuciamna tawh kipawl noptuamna ngah kha loin, gamlapi pan galet-in hopihin, amaute leitungah gamdang mi zinte ahih man-unah upna sungah a si uh hi.
Tua bang a mang mite in, amau ading gam zongin a om uh ci-in a lak uh hi.
Tuate in a paikhiatna gam uh a ngaihsun kik hi le-uh tua gamah ciahkik nading thu a om lai hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in vantung gam ahi, tua sangin a phazaw gam a deih uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in amau Pasian a kicihna maizum loin, amau om nading khuapi a bawlkhol hi.

Abraham in ze-etna a thuak ciangin upna tawh Isaak biakna-ah a pia hi. “Isaak tung bekah na suan na khak kici ding hi,” ci-a thupiak kholhna akipan thuciamnate lungdamin a sang mi hi-in, khat bek a neih tapa a pia hi.
Tua bang a piak ciangin Pasian in sihna pan a thosak thei ding hi ci-in a lungkim hi, etkakna lim-in ci leng, sihna panin a tapa a ngahkik ahi hi.
Isaak in zong upna tawh a piang ding nate ngaihsunin Jakob leh Esau thupha a pia hi.
Jakob in zong a sih ding a naih ciangin upna tawh Josef’ tate nih thupha pia-in, a ciangkhut dawnah kinangin Pasian a bia hi.
Josef in a sih hun a naih ciangin upna tawh Israel mipawlte paikhiatna thu lakin, ama guhte tawh kisai thu a vaikhak hi.
Moses a suah khit ciangin a meel pha a nu leh pa in mu uh a, upna tawh kumpipa’ thupiakna kihta loin, kha thum tawntung a seel uh hi.

Moses in a khan’ a cin’ ciangin mawhna tawh kipawl nopsaknate tawlkhat a ngah sangin, Pasian’ mite tawh bawlsiatna a thuakkhawm ding deihzaw a, Izipt gam sum khempeuh sangin Khazih tawh kipawl kosiatna a lianzaw-ah lungkimin upna tawh Faro’ tanu’ tapa kicihna thu a nial hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a nung ciangin a ngah ding thaman a lamen hi.
Kumpipa’ hehna lau loin upna tawh Izipt gam a taisan hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mittang tawh kimu thei lo Pasian a mu zo bangin a lung kip hi.
Ta upate a sisakpa in Israel mite’ ta upate a sukgawp loh nadingin upna tawh Paisan Pawi ahi zongin, sisan tawh kithehna ahi zongin a bawl uh hi.
Israel mite in upna tawh San Tuipi laizangah lei keu tung tawn bangin a pai uh hi. Tua mite bangin Izipt mite in ahih sawm uh a, tui sungah a tummang uh hi.
Jerikho khuapi ni sagih tawntung uum-in a kimkot khit uh ciangin upna tawh a khuapi kulh a cimkhiasak uh hi.
Numei gilo Rahab in gam ente zawlin manin a inn tungsak ahih manin thungai lote tawh kisia khawm loin, upna tawh a suakta hi.
Tua longal bang ci gen lai ding a om hiam? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jefthah, David, Samuel akipan kamsangte thu teng gen nading hun kicing zo lo hi.
Tua mite in upna tawh gamte a zo uh hi, thuman thu a khen uh hi, thuciamna a ngah uh hi, humpinelkai’ kam a khak uh hi,
meikuang a mitsak uh hi, namsau mai-ah a suakta uh hi, thanemna pan a thahat uh hi, galdona-ah a hang uh hi, gamdang galkapte a taisak uh hi.
Numeite in sihna pan thokikin amau misite a ngah kik uh hi. Kimkhat in a phazaw thawhkikna a ngah nadingun suahtakna sang loin nakpi satna a thuak uh hi.
Kim khatte in kosiatna, satgawpna tham loin, leh-henna, thongkiatnate tawh ze-etna a thuak uh hi.
Suang tawh denna, sing-atna tawh at tanna, ze-etna, namsau tawh thahna a thuak uh hi. Nakpi-in zawngkhalin, bawlsiatna thuakin, tuuvun keelvun silhin a kawivak uh hi.
Hih leitung in tua mite tawh kilawm lo hi. Amaute in gamlak, mual kuam, leihawm, ken hawm sungah a lal kawikawi, a vak kawikawi uh hi.
Tua mite khempeuh in upna tawh teci pan’na a ngah uh hangin kamciamna thu a ngah kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua mite eite tawh loin, kicin’na a tum loh nadingun Pasian in eite ading a phazaw na a ciamteh hi.
